Onlyfun

If you go to settings then to where you see your WiFi name > tap on the gear near the WiFi name > autoconnect > on

If it is already on, turn it off then on.

Alternatively, settings > reset > reset WiFi and Bluetooth

You'll have to re-add Bluetooth and WiFi which often involve passwords

Bluetooth devices ate usually easy default passwords like 0000, 1234 or no password

replies.text: Onlyfun no, it actually did not work. Wifi is on when the phone is started but it never connects to the network, unless you unlock it within the wifi timer. Switching Share network on fixes the issue
